name: tpl-response-2-goal
task: Whenever you are holding the key, the door must be open at that moment or opened afterwards. Then reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Response(has_key, door_open) hard captures 'whenever holding the key, the door must be open at that moment or opened afterwards' (Response allows door_open on the same or later step), and hard Existence(at_goal) makes the goal a requirement. The clauses jointly express the task.

texts: Whenever `has_key` is true, `door_open` must be true at that moment or become true afterwards.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2

(u0, !at_goal&!door_open&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!door_open&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&!door_open&has_key) -> u3
(u0, at_goal&door_open) -> u2
(u1, !at_goal&door_open) -> u0
(u1, at_goal&!door_open) -> u3
(u1, at_goal&door_open) -> u2
(u3, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
